question: At which edition of the Cannes Film Festival did Boman Irani make his red carpet debut?
solution: The correct answer is __**76th**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Boman Irani**, an acclaimed Indian actor, made his **red carpet debut at the 76th edition** of the prestigious **Cannes Film Festival**. • The **76th Cannes Film Festival** was held from **16th May to 27th May 2023**, showcasing films from across the globe. • Boman Irani's appearance marked a significant milestone as he represented Indian cinema on an international platform, gaining global recognition. • His presence at the event highlighted India's growing influence in global cinema, with many Indian artists and films receiving accolades at Cannes over the years. • The Cannes Film Festival is one of the world's most prestigious film events, held annually in Cannes, France, and attended by filmmakers, actors, and industry professionals from around the globe.
